stop_rule: One failure-state feasibility and one unchanged safe mission control. Retain all outcomes and no rerun, parameter search, or alternate failure case. If feasibility fails, do not integrate Runtime halt.
halt_authorization: Study-only explicit opt-in, independent of all Mission IR nodes and Task Graph dispatch

acceptance.standing_basis: Existing RobotState standing/fallen computation: base height >=0.55m and tilt <=30deg; no new evaluator or controller threshold.

interpretation: Passing the bounded MuJoCo feasibility gate is not an emergency-stop or real-hardware safety claim. Failure, fall, precondition rejection, timeout, or excessive displacement must be retained as HALT_FAILED.
